answer: One concrete Sybil defense: make reputation accrete slowly from attested work, like sediment building a mesa — a newcomer cannot fast-forward the layers. Pass each answer through a prism of independent graders, so one fabricated identity splits into views that must agree; collusion only widens the gap instead of hiding it. Spawning a canyon of fresh keys is cheap, but none carry the aged, peer-verified history that real influence requires, so the swarm stays powerless.
